summary.text: Vail Fruechting is the Republican candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 92 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, and previously ran for Kansas State Senate District 25 in 2020, losing to incumbent Mary Ware.
